properties.name: Rule Name
properties.description: Exact new cond.AlarmSuppression Name. It must be 2-256 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, and contain only word characters, spaces, periods, or hyphens. The value is OData-escaped before duplicate lookup.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Optional reason for the alarm suppression. Maximum 120 characters.

properties.name: Start Date
properties.description: Optional complete RFC 3339 timestamp with Z or an explicit UTC offset. It must not be more than 60 seconds in the past when the POST body is built.

properties.name: End Date
properties.description: Optional complete RFC 3339 timestamp with timezone. It must be later than the effective start time when the POST body is built.

properties.name: Rules Operator
properties.description: How Alarm Rules are combined. Allowed values are exactly All and Any; default All.

properties.name: Alarm Rules
properties.description: Required JSON array of exact Property, Operator, and Value objects. Operator must be eq, contains, or in; eq/contains require exactly one string value and in requires one or more string values.

properties.name: Classification Names
properties.description: Optional JSON string array of exact cond.AlarmClassification Names. Names are validated against the current 1-64 character schema, deduplicated in first-occurrence order, OData-escaped, and every name must resolve exactly.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style final status: 2xx for validated creation, 400 for input/body validation, 409 for duplicate names, 404/409 for classification resolution cardinality, and 500/502 for handled helper, response, or API failures.

properties.description: Internal initialized JSON array of exact classification Name, Moid, and ObjectType values. It remains empty when no classifications are requested, preventing references to skipped activity outputs.

Creates reusable rule-based cond.AlarmSuppression with nonempty AlarmRules, All/Any, exact classifications, and RFC 3339 window. Select an intersight.endpoint target authorized to read suppressions/classifications and create the resource. The workflow OData-escapes the unique name, validates eq/contains/in values, resolves each deduplicated classification exactly once, and revalidates JSON/dates before POST; Start Date may be at most 60 seconds past and End Date must follow it. Payload uses typed rule expressions and omits Entity. HTTP 2xx plus validated response proves creation, not current suppression activity, which also depends on scheduling/service state. Lookup and POST are separate, so concurrent same-name creates depend on service uniqueness. Rule Property keywords are tenant-defined and must match current documentation; generic APIs are used because no complete atomic exists.

properties.description: Requires a JSON Results array, validates any returned resource identities, and fails closed with 409 when one or more exact-name suppressions exist.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

duplicateStatus = "helper-failure"
duplicateStatusCode = "500"
duplicateMessage = "Rule-name availability inspection did not complete."
duplicateResultJson = json.dumps({"error": duplicateMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
duplicateResultCount = -1

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("The alarm-suppression response body is not a JSON object.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The alarm-suppression response does not contain a Results array.")
    duplicateResultCount = len(results)
    malformed = []
    for index, item in enumerate(results):
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("Moid"), str) or not item.get("Moid").strip() or item.get("Name") != expectedName or item.get("ObjectType") != "cond.AlarmSuppression":
            malformed.append(index)
    if malformed:
        duplicateStatus = "invalid-resource"
        duplicateStatusCode = "502"
        duplicateMessage = "The duplicate lookup returned malformed or mismatched alarm-suppression identities."
        duplicateResultJson = json.dumps({"error": duplicateMessage, "invalidResultIndexes": malformed, "matchCount": duplicateResultCount}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif duplicateResultCount > 0:
        duplicateStatus = "duplicate"
        duplicateStatusCode = "409"
        duplicateMessage = "Rule Name already exists; a new alarm suppression rule was not created."
        duplicateResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Duplicate Rule Name", "RuleName": expectedName, "matchCount": duplicateResultCount}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        duplicateStatus = "ready"
        duplicateStatusCode = "200"
        duplicateMessage = "Rule Name is available."
        duplicateResultJson = json.dumps({"RuleName": expectedName, "duplicateCount": 0}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    duplicateStatus = "helper-failure"
    duplicateStatusCode = "500"
    duplicateMessage = str(exc)
    duplicateResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Rule-name availability inspection failed", "detail": duplicateMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import sys

classificationStatus = "helper-failure"
classificationStatusCode = "500"
classificationMessage = "Alarm-classification inspection did not complete."
classificationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": classificationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
classificationResolutionJson = ""

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedNames = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("The classification response body is not a JSON object.")
    if not isinstance(expectedNames, list) or not expectedNames or any(not isinstance(name, str) or not name for name in expectedNames) or len(expectedNames) != len(set(expectedNames)):
        raise ValueError("The normalized requested classification names are missing, empty, or not deduplicated.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The classification response does not contain a Results array.")
    byName = {}
    problems = []
    for index, item in enumerate(results):
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            problems.append("Result %d is not an object." % index)
            continue
        name = item.get("Name")
        moid = item.get("Moid")
        objectType = item.get("ObjectType")
        if name not in expectedNames:
            problems.append("Result %d has an unexpected Name." % index)
        elif name in byName:
            problems.append("Classification Name %s was returned more than once." % name)
        elif not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip():
            problems.append("Classification %s is missing a usable Moid." % name)
        elif objectType != "cond.AlarmClassification":
            problems.append("Classification %s has an unexpected ObjectType." % name)
        else:
            byName[name] = {"Name": name, "Moid": moid, "ObjectType": objectType}
    missing = [name for name in expectedNames if name not in byName]
    if problems:
        classificationStatus = "invalid-resource"
        classificationStatusCode = "502"
        classificationMessage = " ".join(problems)
        classificationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Classification response validation failed", "details": problems, "missingNames": missing}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif missing or len(results) != len(expectedNames):
        classificationStatus = "cardinality"
        classificationStatusCode = "404" if missing else "409"
        classificationMessage = "Every deduplicated Classification Name must resolve exactly once."
        classificationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Classification lookup cardinality failure", "requestedNames": expectedNames, "missingNames": missing, "returnedCount": len(results), "requiredCount": len(expectedNames)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        resolution = [byName[name] for name in expectedNames]
        classificationResolutionJson = json.dumps(resolution, separators=(",", ":"))
        classificationStatus = "ready"
        classificationStatusCode = "200"
        classificationMessage = "Every deduplicated Classification Name resolved exactly once with a usable Moid."
        classificationResultJson = json.dumps({"resolvedCount": len(resolution), "requestedNames": expectedNames, "Moids": [item["Moid"] for item in resolution]}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    classificationStatus = "helper-failure"
    classificationStatusCode = "500"
    classificationMessage = str(exc)
    classificationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Alarm-classification inspection failed", "detail": classificationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
